purpose: Unified public evidence from the Revvy Google/Yandex Maps export plus the newly captured Yandex Maps/Eda review cards. UI Maps are linked to the previous Yandex Maps export to avoid counting the same card twice; no raw text, author names, phones, or customer IDs are stored.

interpretation: The current Maps card rating 5.0/276 and the 2022–2026 Revvy archive are different snapshots and possibly different populations/formulas; this comparison is not evidence of rating manipulation.
No individual ratings are present for the three Yandex Eda text reviews; the card-level 4.8/17 is not assigned to individual rows.

Eda review dated 25 September is coded for taste/quality and temperature as separate observations. The review mentions a courier without a thermal bag, but no causal link to temperature is inferred; it also praises the rolls, so the whole order is not called a failure.
Counts are public reviews/opinions, not unique people or order-level defect rates. Google–Yandex cross-posts are preserved as possible overlaps and shown in a separate deduplication scenario.
Google source dates have low day-level precision, documented in the base coded dataset; do not treat historical Google day/month or recency as verified.
